comparison.objective: Align, push, and quarter-turn a bayonet cap until mechanically locked; the candidate locks a threaded adjustment with a jam nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed insertion against a spring followed by one-part twist, not simultaneous wrench/driver countertorque on concentric threaded parts.
comparison.success_condition: Cap axis, orientation, lug rotation, roof engagement, release, and 1 s stillness establish success; candidate requires a 90° stop retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both end in a lock, but bayonet mating tests keyed push-and-twist engagement rather than preservation of an adjustable setting.
